replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Feedback:
- Add more structures to make the map less flat to provide better game-play.

- The map seems kinda blocky (The stair cases). Try to make them more "shaped" and fewer amounts, so it would be easier PVP rather than climbing up tons of stairs.

- Too much void gap? There seems to be too much void in the middle and less place for PVP. Try adding some islands in the middle.

Good luck, and keep up the awesome work!

replies.author: Trexychan
replies.body:
I like the fact that you prioritize bow-combat. But as I explain things the map needs, you can see why I am concerned about it as well.

As for map work, the monuments should be behind some sort of defense right off the bat. Cobwebs, fences, anything to make the game longer.

Like the rest of these people, I agree that there is just simply not enough room for melee combat. The center isle being so thin, bow spamming WOULD be commonplace.

The overlapping parts should also have hazards to make players think twice about taking it. Make it thinner so they get shot off, cobwebs, random holes in the ground, anything to make it more of a challenge. As of right now rushing the left mon is too easy.

Floor Decor is a good thing to add. The map's aesthetics would be much more pleasing. The two most prominent things that bug me are where the spawn is (I assume in that sheltered thingy) and if it is where I think it is, why the last mon is freakishly close to it. Personally it would be somewhat impossible to break that, unless you have the teamwork and manpower to overcome it. I would suggest just adding the said iron deposits instead.

It is good that you showed this in WIP state, I believe the sooner you get feedback, the better your map will be.
